name: insurancexdate
description: TypeScript MCP server for the InsuranceXDate workers'-comp prospect database, Form 5500 benefits search, SERFF rate-filing API, and account workflow tools. 13 tools: search, benefits_search, match, filter, company_details, talkpoints, serff_search, serff_filing, flagged_companies, groups, group_companies, saved_searches, run_saved_search.
long_description: Wraps the InsuranceXDate REST API and MCP endpoints. Works with any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, Zed, Cline, custom). Implements parameter translation between upstream MCP and REST schemas, URL decoding for company UIDs returned by REST search and consumed by MCP detail lookups, bounded upstream requests and responses, stable error handling, structuredContent on search and match results for typed LLM reasoning, schema validation via zod (state codes, dates, premium / mod / employee bands, addloptions and policyoptions enums, datamode lock on benefits search), and default-deny paid-tool gating. Uses the locked @modelcontextprotocol/sdk dependency and Node 20+. This .mcpb bundle targets Claude Desktop's one-click install path; the same server source works on any MCP client via stdio. Unofficial third-party client; not affiliated with InsuranceXDate.

api_key.title: InsuranceXDate API Key
api_key.description: Your InsuranceXDate API key from https://www.insurancexdate.com/settings.php#api (API/MCP tab). Stored in your OS keychain (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain).

disable_paid_tools.title: Paid tools (default disabled)
disable_paid_tools.description: Paid and unverified stored-content tools are disabled by default. Set to '0', 'false', 'no', or 'off' only when you explicitly authorize company_details ($0.25), talkpoints ($0.10), serff_filing ($0.10), serff_search ($0.05 — all four ledger-confirmed 2026-07-03; charges draw from the $5/mo included allowance first, then the XChange balance), and group_companies / run_saved_search (upstream declares them free but they execute stored account content that could not be behavior-verified). Any blank, true, or unrecognized value keeps them omitted from tools/list and unable to make network calls. The always-free tools remain enabled; account-read tools among them still expose agency flag/pipeline lists and saved-search names to the connected client.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free workers' comp prospect search. Covers working upstream filter params: state/dates/class/sic/industry/county/carrier/carrier-group/agent/peo lists, premium/mod/employee ranges, policyoptions (AR/MULTISTATE/PEO), addloptions (BENEFITS/DOT/NPO/OSHA/PEO). naicslist is intentionally not exposed because the upstream REST endpoint ignores it (re-verified 2026-07-03). Q3 2026 dedicated DOT/NPO databases are not API-exposed; the addloptions flags remain the API-side signal.

tools.name: benefits_search
tools.description: Free (per upstream declaration) Form 5500 benefits-plan search via upstream MCP datamode 1 (retirement: participants/assets/commissions/providers) and 2 (health: premiums/commission %/loss ratios/brokers). Only behavior-verified params exposed; workers' comp deliberately excluded (stays on search/REST).

tools.name: match
tools.description: Free find-by-name endpoint via /api2/Match. Look up a business by any of name/fein/phone/address, optionally scoped by state. Returns UID. FEIN must be digits-only (hyphenated returns zero — verified 2026-07-03). No additional service required per XDate support; fuzzy lookup returns the highest-score match.

tools.name: filter
tools.description: Free filter-value lookup (carriers, carrier groups, classes, SIC, industries, counties, agents, PEO providers, NAICS codes for SERFF industry filters, SERFF insurance-type codes, SERFF severity-type categories). policyoptions and addloptions are fixed enums on search, not filter-tool lookups.

tools.name: company_details
tools.description: Gated ($0.25/call LEDGER-CONFIRMED 2026-07-03; same-day same-record dedupe confirmed, but the advertised 90-day window failed a live test — plan on same-day only): full company details by UID — summary, user_status, details, carrier_history[], _meta. Optional scope blocks VERIFIED 2026-07-03: contacts[] (name/email/phone/LinkedIn — restored via scope), altloc -> other_locations key, tabs -> osha + benefits blocks + a dot[] block on DOT-FLAGGED companies (keys on the dot flag, not industry — fleet operators like pest control/pool care/NEMT carry it too; 35 MCS-150 fields incl. safety rating, power units, drivers, coverage, policy number).

tools.name: talkpoints
tools.description: Gated ($0.10, confirmed on Jun 26-27 ledger rows; assume same-day dedupe only — the advertised 90-day window failed a live test): prospecting talking points by UID

tools.name: serff_search
tools.description: Gated ($0.05/call LEDGER-CONFIRMED 2026-07-03 — vendor metadata's 'free' claim disproven; NO dedupe, repeats charge): SERFF rate-filing search. carrier_naic now optional; server-side filters incl. severity comma-lists, policyholders_min, industry_naic_prefix, naics3 (verified 2026-07-03) plus industry_naic, policyholders_max (upstream-declared).

tools.name: serff_filing
tools.description: Gated ($0.10/call LEDGER-CONFIRMED 2026-07-03; same-day same-filing dedupe confirmed, treat the advertised 90-day window as unreliable): full SERFF filing details

tools.name: flagged_companies
tools.description: Free (per upstream declaration; behavior-probed 2026-07-03): list companies you or your agency flagged (save/contacted/quoting/written/nextyear/followup/appt), with sort and pagination.

tools.name: groups
tools.description: Free (per upstream declaration; behavior-probed 2026-07-03): list saved company groups, incl. groups shared by agency members.

tools.name: group_companies
tools.description: Gated (upstream declares free but executes stored account content that could not be behavior-verified — no saved groups existed to probe): companies in a saved group, search-format results.

tools.name: saved_searches
tools.description: Free (per upstream declaration; behavior-probed 2026-07-03): list saved prospect-search definitions.

tools.name: run_saved_search
tools.description: Gated (upstream declares free but executes a stored search definition the wrapper cannot inspect; could not be behavior-verified — no saved searches existed to probe): run a saved search by id, search-format results.
